description.en: Original cave-boxwork teaching exposure: thin intersecting mineral fins with real thickness form irregular open cells attached to one finite eroded rock face, with unequal heights and residual-rock thickness hierarchy. The generic speleogen concept represents more resistant fracture filling exposed by host erosion, not ordinary dripping stalagmite growth, an equal grid, detached panels or a three-dimensional reticulite foam. Nominal65cm patch, mineral palette and display face are artistic; no cave locality or microcrystal claim.
description.zh: 原创洞穴箱状构造教学露面：有真实厚度的相交薄矿物片围成不规则开放格室，附着有限蚀退岩面，高度与残岩厚度分层。示意裂隙填充物较抗蚀后外露的speleogen，非滴水石笋/等距格网/漂浮板片/三维reticulite泡沫；名义65厘米、矿物配色及展示面属美术，不指定洞址微晶。
